It is huge! Is it the biggest palace in Istanbul?
It is one of the biggest. The Ottoman emperors lived here for about four hundred years.
Amazing. And that great dome over there -- is it Hagia Sophia?

Welcome to Hagia Sophia, one of the most famous buildings in the world. It was built in the sixth century, in the year five hundred and thirty-seven, by the emperor Justinian. For almost one thousand years, it was the biggest church in the world. Look up at the dome. It is fifty-five meters high, and many people think it is the most beautiful dome in Istanbul. Later, in the Ottoman Empire, the building became a mosque. Today it is a mosque again, so visitors have to follow the mosque rules. Please stay with the group, because it is one of the busiest places in the city.

Hi Marlene, it is Selin. I have a great idea for your last evening in Istanbul. Go to the Galata Tower at sunset. It was built in thirteen forty-eight, and it is one of the oldest towers in the city. From the top, you can see the best view of Istanbul: the palaces, the domes of the mosques and the sea. The tower is sixty-seven meters high, but there is an elevator, so you do not have to walk. It is the most popular place in the evening, so buy your ticket online. After that, walk down to the water and have a fish sandwich. See you tomorrow!

First, you visit Hagia Sophia, the oldest building of the three, and you look up at the great dome. Then you walk to Topkapi Palace, where the emperors lived for four hundred years. Next, you see the old ruins near the walls of the city. After that, you go up the Galata Tower at sunset. Finally, you see the best view of Istanbul, and you take the most beautiful photo of your trip.
